evidence_items.explanation: The official definition supports dividing facility energy by PUE; applying it to capacity additionally assumes comparable loading. Using the claim's inputs produces approximately the stated revenue, but does not establish an economic break-even requirement.

inputs: 15.2 GW facility capacity, stipulated in the claim
USD 14 million per MW per year, stipulated in the claim
derived.formula: IT capacity = 15.2 / 1.35 = 11.259259... GW. Annual revenue = (15.2 / 1.35) × 1,000 × USD 14,000,000 = USD 157.629629... billion. Using the claim's approximate 11.2 GW gives USD 156.8 billion.
derived.rounding: Unrounded inputs give USD 157.63 billion, about 0.53% above USD 156.8 billion. The difference is immaterial to 'around'; 11.2 GW is a downward approximation rather than ordinary rounding to one decimal.
